profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and identified by CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for the most important business processes at the world's largest organizations, and says the company has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site presents a unified platform for orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people, with offerings grouped around process automation, giving AI reliability and control, and modernizing legacy applications with AI. It says customers build AI-powered processes on the platform, including low-code apps with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Listed use cases include accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and contracts, audit and compliance, case management, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, which the site says can cut time by up to 50%, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review. Appian states it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and its site points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services and a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in Virginia, with 152 matters.
